verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a public REST API reference for customers, partners and community developers. It uses resource-oriented JSON:API endpoints, request/response schemas and Lucene search, embeds a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and has a dated, backwards-compatibility versioning policy. The features page says the API reaches any object in the account and supports custom resources, which together cover driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API use, and a standalone raw-spec download plus documented auth and rate-limit details.
